summary: Frontend-only verification of /margine iter24: unpaid jobs now re-appear in Dettaglio lavori in muted gray with expected margin, without any 'non incassato' tag or 'ancora da incassare' badge. Seeded 3 TEST_IT24 clients in 2026-10 via API (A paid 500 bonifico, B unpaid 1000, C partial 500/1000 contanti). All 10 assertions pass on live preview. Totals: big card +1000,00 € · '3 lavori eseguiti', Contanti 500,00 €, Bonifico/POS 500,00 € (Bonifico 500 · POS 0). Row A: name text-stone-800 (dark), amount text-[#2E5A47] (green). Row B: name text-stone-500 (muted), amount text-stone-400 (muted gray), value shown = expected margin 1000,00 € (not zero), no acconto/atteso. Row C: name text-stone-800, amount green, 'acconto' pill present, 'atteso 1000,00 €' subtitle present. Forbidden strings absent. Test data cleaned up (3x DELETE 200).
critical_code_review_comments: Margine.jsx: 'unpaid' flag at line 258 correctly identifies rows with collectedMargin<=0.01 and gates both name color (text-stone-500 vs text-stone-800) and amount color/value (text-stone-400 + expectedMargin). Partial path still works (acconto pill + atteso subtitle).
rows[].pending (line 140) remains computed but is unused in the JSX. Minor cleanup opportunity, non-blocking.

byMethod computation (lines 54-83) still short-circuits when payments.length===0, so unpaid rows do NOT leak into per-method totals as required. Verified: unpaid 1000€ client contributed 0 to Contanti/Bonifico/POS.
